LESSON: PRODUCTION UNIT

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship 5.1 Introduction to Entrepreneurship (4 lessons) By the end of 
Topic 5.2: Production Unit

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Production Unit. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Production Unit
2. Practise Production Unit at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Production Unit

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Production Unit
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Production Unit. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Production Unit at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Production Unit at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Production Unit
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Production Unit. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Production Unit using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Production Unit in the examples.
2. Explain Production Unit to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Production Unit.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Production Unit using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Production Unit important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Production Unit
2. Practise Production Unit at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Production Unit

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
